title: Rabbi Yehudah the Tailor

paragraphs: Hyman describes him as Rabbi’s student and an expert scribe. In the episode he cites from Bava Batra 164b, Yehudah wrote a Psalms scroll for Rabbi. On seeing it, Rabbi said, “How fine and straight this writing is!” His son Rabbi Shimon told him that Rabbi Yehudah the Tailor had written it.

notes.text: Chayata means “the Tailor.” Rabbi’s son Shimon identifies the scribe; he is not described as the scribe’s son.
In the consulted passage, Rabbi’s son Shimon names Yehudah the Tailor in the preceding exchange about a document. The subsequent Psalms episode continues that dialogue.
